authorRole.en: Independent publisher of county-level plan tables and cost calculators for people turning 65

authorDesc.en: Radif Partners reads the plan landscape files that CMS publishes each September, county by county, and turns them into tables anyone can scan: monthly premium, drug deductible, in-network out-of-pocket limit and star rating for every plan filed for 2027. The premium, IRMAA and Part D figures come from the CMS fact sheets, the SSA operations manual and the 2027 Rate Announcement, each linked and dated on the page that uses it. This site is not run by, endorsed by or connected to the federal government, sells no insurance and passes nobody's details to an agent.
